query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.authProvider, u.emailVerified, u.password IS NOT NULL as hasPassword, ou.organizationId, ou.role as orgRole
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN organization_users ou ON u.id = ou.userId
WHERE u.id = 8100011 OR u.email = 'debbie.gregory0153@gmail.com';
